01 / Core abstractions

Core abstractions

Eight concepts describe the entities, state, possibilities, actions, processes, and changes in an interactive world. Open a row for its definition and example.

01Worldthe current state of everything
What it is

The container for current entities, relationships, registered actions, and ordered events.

Exampleworld.snapshot()
→ entities + relationships + actions
Source ↗
02Entitya stable identity for one thing
What it is

An ID, label, type, and component map. The entity is intentionally light; its components carry meaning.

Examplerobot_01
type: core.robot
Source ↗
03Componentstate or ability attached to an entity
What it is

A composable piece of state or capability such as locomotion, transform, observable, power, vision, or audio.

Examplerobot_01.components.locomotion
→ { state: "ready" }
Source ↗
04Relationshipa directed fact connecting two entities
What it is

A first-class subject–predicate–object connection, with optional metadata.

Examplerobot_01 — located_in — world_local
robot_01 — observes — world_local
Source ↗
05Affordancewhat is possible right now
What it is

An action currently available to an actor and optional target, including the reason when it is unavailable.

Exampleworld.affordancesFor("robot_01")
→ connect · observe · map · stop
Source ↗
06Actiona meaningful operation that changes the world
What it is

An operation with actor and target requirements. It can update components, create relationships, return a result, and emit events.

Exampleworld.execute({
action_id: "world.map"
})
Source ↗
07Systema process that keeps the world moving
What it is

A continuous process that senses, updates, executes, or emits events. Systems connect the model to time and external reality.

Examplesense → update → execute
→ emit → repeat
Design notes ↗
08Eventan ordered record of a world change
What it is

A sequence-numbered record with a timestamp, type, involved entities, and event data.

Exampleaction.started
world.mapping_enabled
action.completed
Source ↗
02 / Architecture

Architecture

Adapters translate physical or simulated systems into the same world model. An optional governance path surrounds action execution when authorization and control-plane guarantees are required.

active pathLive Go2 world
Go2 sensors→standard robot port→robot-world adapter→World Runtime→operator panel
optional pathGovernance
Mission API→Mission Server→signed Authorization→Supervisor Kernel→Driver

Event Log is the cross-cutting record. Scene, Attention, Replay, and Reports are projections over it. The governance packages are retained as an optional extension; the World Runtime does not depend on them.

03 / Service contracts

Service contracts

Reference TypeScript signatures for the service boundaries. The normative payloads and rules remain in the NEM Suite specification.

type Id = string;
type Timestamp = string;
type Json = Record<string, unknown>;

/** Client-facing policy and mission boundary. */
export interface MissionApi {
  health(): Promise<Health>;                         // GET /health
  createMission(input: CreateMission): Promise<Mission>;
  getMission(missionId: Id): Promise<Mission>;
  completeMission(missionId: Id, result: Json): Promise<Mission>;
  listRobots(): Promise<RobotSummary[]>;
  getRobotStatus(robotId: Id): Promise<NormalizedStatus>;
  getRobotVerbs(robotId: Id): Promise<Verb[]>;
  proposeRun(input: RunProposal): Promise<Run>;
  getRun(runId: Id): Promise<Run>;
  approveRun(runId: Id, reason?: string): Promise<RunExecution>;
  rejectRun(runId: Id, reason?: string): Promise<Run>;
  replayRun(runId: Id): Promise<Replay>;
  stopRobot(robotId: Id): Promise<StopReceipt>;
  clearRobotStop(robotId: Id): Promise<StopReceipt>;
  getScene(since?: Id): Promise<Scene | SceneDelta>;
  getEntity(entityId: Id): Promise<EntityWithProvenance>;
  getAttention(missionId: Id): Promise<AttentionState>;
  drainAttention(missionId: Id, cause?: string): Promise<Digest>;
  waitAttention(missionId: Id, input: WaitInput): Promise<Digest>;
  openAnomaly(input: AnomalyInput): Promise<Anomaly>;
  updateAnomaly(anomalyId: Id, patch: Json): Promise<Anomaly>;
  registry(operation: RegistryOperation): Promise<RegistryState>;
}

/** Durable ordered evidence. Every projection is derived from this log. */
export interface EventLog {
  append(event: EventInput): EventEnvelope;             // durable before return
  read(filter: EventFilter, cursor?: number, limit?: number): EventEnvelope[];
  tail(filter: EventFilter): AsyncIterable<EventEnvelope>;
}

/** Signed, single-use permission crossing policy into control. */
export type Authorization = {
  id: Id; runId: Id; missionId: Id; robotId: Id;
  grant: StreamGrant | DiscreteGrant;
  enforcement: EnforcementMap;
  target?: { entityId: Id; snapshotId: Id };
  streamsGranted: string[]; abortTriggers: AbortTrigger[];
  capability: { verb: string; impl: string };
  checks: CheckResult[]; issuedAt: Timestamp; expiresAt: Timestamp;
  signature: string;
};

/** Millisecond control-plane boundary; no scene or policy dependency. */
export interface SupervisorKernel {
  status(): KernelStatus;                                  // GET /status
  stop(source?: string): StopReceipt;                      // POST /stop
  execute(authorization: Authorization): ExecuteReceipt;   // POST /execute
  submitChunk(chunk: ActionChunk): ChunkAck;               // chunks/{authId}
  events(after?: number): EventEnvelope[];                 // WS /events
}

/** Vendor-neutral hardware boundary. */
export interface Driver {
  manifest(): DriverManifest;
  connect(config?: Json): void;
  disconnect(): void;
  status(): NormalizedStatus;
  setSetpoint(space: string, setpoint: Json): void;
  executeDiscrete(action: string, params: Json, deadlineMs: number): Ack;
  commandSafeState(): Ack;
  openStream(name: string): AsyncIterable<unknown>;
  events(): DriverEvent[];
}

/** Sandboxed executor: evidence in, bounded ActionChunks out. */
export interface Capability {
  describe(): CapabilityManifest;
  bind(auth: Authorization, target: Json, streams: StreamEndpoints): Ready;
  start(): void;
  onFrame(stream: string, frame: unknown): void;
  emitChunk(chunk: ActionChunk): void;
  emitObservation(observation: Observation): void;
  emitEvent(type: string, payload: Json): void;
  abort(trigger: AbortTrigger): void;
  stop(): void;
  terminate(): RunResult;
}

/** Log-backed belief projection and deterministic physics derivation. */
export interface SceneProjection {
  getScene(): Scene;
  getSceneSince(snapshotId: Id): SceneDelta;
  getEntity(entityId: Id): EntityWithProvenance;
  buildWorldTwin(pin: WorldTwinPin): WorldTwin;
}

/** Per-mission, per-principal event delivery contract. */
export interface AttentionInbox {
  contract(): AttentionContract;
  pending(): number;
  drain(input?: DrainInput): Digest;
  wait(input: WaitInput): Promise<Digest>;
}

/** Organization-owned package and preset state. */
export interface PolicyRegistry {
  list(): RegistryState[];
  get(packageId: Id): RegistryState;
  install(bundle: PackageBundle): RegistryState;
  pin(packageId: Id): RegistryState;
  enable(packageId: Id): RegistryState;
  promote(packageId: Id): RegistryState;
  demote(packageId: Id): RegistryState;
  revoke(packageId: Id): RegistryState;
}

MissionApi is the client surface; Authorization is the only artifact that can cause physical action. The other interfaces are the log, control, hardware, capability, projection, attention, and policy boundaries behind it.

04 / Database tables

Database tables

Proposed Postgres v0 inventory. The repository currently uses in-memory and file-backed reference components; no SQL migrations are checked in.

NameTypeDescription
event_logappend-only sourceImmutable ordered events for state changes, observations, policy decisions, control actions, and replay.
missionsstate machineMission identity, lifecycle, principal, robot roster, and the pinned preset version.
runsstate machineOne proposed operation from proposal through approval, execution, rejection, abort, expiry, or result.
authorizationssigned artifactDurable signed permission binding one run to a robot, bounded grant, target snapshot, capability, streams, checks, and expiry.
anomaliesoperational recordSafety or operational mismatch with severity, evidence, suspected cause, owner, closure criteria, and status.
registry_statetrust stateOrganization-owned package enablement, pinning, maturity, gauntlet evidence, and history.
idempotency_recordsrequest cacheOriginal responses for repeated mutations keyed by principal, idempotency key, method, and path.
scene_projection_snapshotsmaterialized projectionFast /scene snapshots with source cursor, ontology versions, freshness, robots, and hazards.
entity_projection_snapshotsmaterialized projectionStable entities per scene snapshot, including type, components, affordances, relationships, freshness, and provenance.
attention_contractsmaterialized contractPer-mission, per-principal filters, wake predicate, budget, digest version, and pinned preset versions.
attention_seamsdelivery recordDigest delivery boundaries: cause, cursor range, digest version, digest reference, and coalescing counts.
replay_artifactsrebuildable cacheOptional cached run replay or report output; canonical evidence remains in the Event Log.
normalized_status_cacheread cacheLatest driver status for robot reads and freshness checks; it is not control authority.
artifactsbinary metadata/refDatabase-backed references for images, masks, point clouds, audio, video, and other evidence.

Not separate v0 tables: observations and telemetry are event payloads; label_map.json and types.json are versioned ontology inputs; presets and reports are pinned artifacts or log-backed state. ClickHouse is a later analytical mirror.

05 / Current state

Current state

The first World Runtime slice is implemented and connected to the live Go2 operator surface. The next step is turning sensor evidence into semantic entities and relationships, then binding physical action packs to the same actions used in simulation.
